result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a misaligned card in the Fastest near you carousel and inconsistent wishlist heart button styling in Popular right now.

issues.description: Middle card 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically offset lower than the neighboring cards. Its image top and title baseline do not align with 'Green Bowl Pok�e9' on the left and 'Trattoria Piccol' on the right, creating a staggered/jagged row.
issues.suggestion: Align all cards in the horizontal carousel to the same top baseline with equal image height and text spacing so the row is uniform

issues.description: Wishlist heart icon styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now': the heart on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows as a white outline directly on the image with no background, while the heart on the pizza card below has a dark semi-transparent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent heart-button style with the dark circular scrim/background to all restaurant cover images for visibility and consistency
